invariants.rationale: The loaders called by this method are expected to produce and return a (non-null) TiledMap object when a supported file is given.
The only possible return paths require a supported file extension (.tmx or .tmj); otherwise, an exception is thrown.
If parameter is passed as null, a new instance is created and used, so parameter is never null at the return point.
The result is always a TiledMap, as all delegate loaders (atlasTmxMapLoader, tmxMapLoader, etc) return a TiledMap.
fileName is required for file resolution and extension checks; method contract assumes it is not null for successful return.
